answer: A strong Sybil defense is a stake-bonded inlet: every new agent identity must lock a refundable deposit before it can transact, so spawning thousands of fake accounts costs real capital. Peers then mirror each other's behavior records on a shared ledger, so a swarm copying one script leaves an umber trail of identical timing and wording that stands out against genuine diverse agents. Attackers pay per identity and still get caught by correlation.
